author: More Perfect Union
description:
The real cause of Puerto Rico's massive water crisis isn't being covered.

180,000 people on the island are going 48 hours at a time without water.

Beneath this crisis is decades of U.S. mismanagement and neglect, leading infrastructure to crumble.

Host: Dean Huertas
Supervising Producer: Victoria Hammett
Editor: Andrew Rivera
title: There's a water crisis in Puerto Rico — and the media is missing the deeper cause

author: More Perfect Union
description:
A resident in Marietta, Georgia questioned why a data center proposal had four completely redacted pages as well as other partially redacted information during a city council meeting to approve rezoning for said data center.

He was ignored. And Marietta City Council voted to approve the rezoning anyways.
title: Resident calls out data center proposal for having four completely redacted pages
